paragraphs.text: Pontotoc High School is listed in Class 5A for the 2027–29 cycle, while North Pontotoc and South Pontotoc are listed in Class 4A in the Mississippi High School Activities Association’s new classification release.

The association’s linked table gives Pontotoc an adjusted enrollment of 490, North Pontotoc 398 and South Pontotoc 353. Those figures are the adjusted-enrollment numbers shown in the classification table.

The released list places 24 schools in Class 5A and 40 in Class 4A. The listed lower enrollment threshold is 467 for 5A and 306 for 4A, with schools organized by adjusted enrollment within each class.

The new release covers the future 2027–29 cycle. For current football context, the association’s 2025–27 alignment lists Pontotoc in 5A and North Pontotoc and South Pontotoc in 4A. The new classification table lists classes and enrollment; it does not list sport-specific regions or schedules.
